_engines.generic_json: params: {api_url, method, payload, jobs_path, fields{title,location,url,desc,posted}, pagination{kind: offset|page|next_url|none, step, start, param, next_path, max_pages}, headers, url_prefix, url_field} — for custom portals whose JSON endpoint was found by discover_board.py
_engines.oracle: params: {host, site} — Oracle Recruiting Cloud host + site number/name
_engines.workday: params: {host, tenant, site} — host like <tenant>.wd5.myworkdayjobs.com, tenant = Workday tenant name, site = career site name

_how_to_add: 1) Run: python3 discover_board.py <careers-page-URL>  2) If it reports a working engine + sample count, paste the suggested entry below.  3) Test: python3 fetch_browser_boards.py --dry-run --board <Company>  4) If clean, run without --dry-run and commit.
_schema: Browser-boards engine config (fetch_browser_boards.py). One entry per employer career page. EVERY job is classified into one of the 15 courses (TRACK_FILTERS) — a posting matching no course is dropped. aml-kyc additionally requires aml_gate(). Location must be India or Remote/global. Public pages only; never behind login.
